We got three templates. The first one (reaction_id 1914389) seems to match HWE: It has mapped_rxn with C-C double bond formation and phosphonate leaving group. The retro_smarts_template shows product to reactants: product is alkene with OH (carboxylic acid) and reactants include phosphonate and aldehyde. This is likely the correct template.

We need to return mapped_rxn and template_id (the one used to search the database not the hash). The template_id likely is the integer ID used in search results? In result dict, there is 'reaction_id' and 'template_hash'. The template_id maybe the reaction_id? Or there is a separate field. The description: "return the `template_id` (the one used to search the database not the hash) as an integer". In search results, each entry includes 'reaction_id' (maybe the template ID). Usually template catalog entries have 'template_id' field. Here we have 'reaction_id' which is likely the template ID. We'll assume template_id = 1914389.

Thus answer: mapped_rxn from first entry, template_id 1914389.

Let's extract mapped_rxn string: It's long. Provided in result: 

'[CH3:1][CH:2]([CH3:3])[N:4]1[C:5](=[O:6])[C@@H:7]([CH2:8][CH:9]=O)[O:14][C@H:15]([C:16]2=[C:17]([Cl:18])[CH:19]=[CH:20][CH:21]=[CH:22]2)[C:23]2=[C:24]1[CH:25]=[CH:26][C:27]([Cl:28])=[CH:29]2.CC[O:13][C:11](=[O:12])[CH:10]=P(C1=CC=CC=C1)(C1=CC=CC=C1)C1=CC=CC=C1.CC1=CC=CC=C1>>[CH3:1][CH:2]([CH3:3])[N:4]1[C:5](=[O:6])[C@@H:7]([CH2:8]/[CH:9]=[CH:10]/[C:11](=[O:12])[OH:13])[O:14][C@H:15]([c:16]2[c:17]([Cl:18])[cH:19][cH:20][cH:21][cH:22]2)[c:23]2[c:24]1[cH:25][cH:26][c:27]([Cl:28])[cH:29]2'

But that's from second template? Wait first entry's mapped_rxn is:

' O=[CH:8][CH2:7][C@@H:6]1[O:5][C@H:4](/[CH:3]=[C:2](/[CH3:1])[CH2:27][OH:28])[C@H:25]([CH3:26])[C@@H:16]([O:17][Si:18]([CH3:19])([CH3:20])[C:21]([CH3:22])([CH3:23])[CH3:24])[CH2:15]1.CCOP(=O)(OCC)[CH2:9]/[CH:10]=[CH:11]/[C:12](=[O:13])[O:14]CC>>[CH3:1]/[C:2](=[CH:3]/[C@H:4]1[O:5][C@@H:6]([CH2:7]/[CH:8]=[CH:9]/[CH:10]=[CH:11]/[C:12](=[O:13])[OH:14])[CH2:15][C@H:16]([O:17][Si:18]([CH3:19])([CH3:20])[C:21]([CH3:22])([CH3:23])[CH3:24])[C@H:25]1[CH3:26])[CH2:27][OH:28]'

That's the mapped_rxn for HWE. So we should use that.

Thus final answer JSON.
